description: This file defines the XMLWriter class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing additional functionality for XML writing, including temporary file handling, data retrieval, and raw data writing, along with error handling and debug options.

classes.name: XMLWriter
classes.description: A subclass of PHP's XMLWriter providing temporary storage management, data extraction, and raw data writing functionalities specific to the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the XMLWriter with specified temporary storage options, falling back to memory if disk storage fails.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up temporary files on object destruction.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object, throwing an exception if attempted.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the written XML data either from memory or temporary file.

methods.name: writeRawData
methods.description: Wrapper method to write raw data after escaping special HTML characters.
